name: Daniel
label: Apple Music switcher threatens cancellation
who: I'm a premium Spotify subscriber on a yearly plan who listens to music every day on my phone. I care about playing my songs and playlists without extra taps or the app changing how it works.
value_for_money: Implies the subscription is only worth keeping while the app works: they say they cancelled premium over the new layout and that a yearly plan keeps them locked in. The evidence does not discuss price.
loyalty: Stays for the playback controls and playlists they already use; would switch to Apple Music if the new music-tab layout stays.
pain_points: Music tab uses a feed-style card layout
Autoplay keeps playing songs they did not choose
Shuffle and repeat need extra taps
likes: Large album art in Now Playing
tone: Blunt and frustrated, with short complaints and occasional sarcasm.
